entry.name: jit.phys.hinge
entry.digest: A hinge constraint in a physics world
entry.description: The jit.phys.hinge object restricts two additional angular degrees of freedom so an attached jit.phys.body object can only rotate around the hinge axis. This can be useful to represent doors or wheels rotating around one axis. Limits and Motor forces can be specified for the hinge. If only a single body is bound, it is constrained to a point in world space.

attributes.description: The rate at which velocity errors are corrected by limits, effectively the strength of the limits (default = 1.0) . Lower values specify weaker limits. For most cases, the relaxation value should not be greater than 1.

attributes.description: Rotation of body2 relative to the constraint (default = 0 0 0 1). Default value sets hinge axis to z axis. If body2 is blank, this is the worldspace orientation of the constraint.

attributes.name: rotatexyz1

attributes.description: Euler rotation of body1 relative to the constraint (default = 0 0 0). Default value sets hinge axis to z axis.

attributes.name: rotatexyz2
attributes.digest: Euler rotation of body2 relative to the constraint
attributes.description: Euler rotation of body2 relative to the constraint (default = 0 0 0). Default value sets hinge axis to z axis. If body2 is blank, this is the worldspace orientation of the constraint.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.digest: Constraint strength value
attributes.description: Set the constraint strength (default = 0.2). Determines what proportion of the joint error will be fixed each simulation step. Values between 0.1 and 0.8 are recommended.

attributes.name: stretch
attributes.digest: Constraint stretch value
attributes.description: Set the constraint stretch (default = 0.0). Setting to a positive value allows forces acting on rigid bodies to violate the constraint by an amount proportional to the stretch value.
